description: Yusuf El-Masri serves as the Operations Director of Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co (ACCHCO). ACCHCO operates the primary container terminal at the Port of Alexandria.

timeline.entry: Yusuf El-Masri, the Operations Director of Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co, took part in an initial call concerning the company's RFP for a full operational transformation of its main container terminal.
Yusuf El-Masri is identified as the Operations Director of Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co, which operates the main container terminal at the Port of Alexandria.

Yusuf El-Masri, Operations Director of Alexandria Container & Cargo Handling Co., confirmed the three‑phase Transformation at ACCHCO engagement and proposed scheduling its kickoff for the week of March 23 at the company’s Alexandria offices.
Yusuf El-Masri provided RPX Optimization full access to ACCHCO’s terminal operating system data during the Alexandria kickoff, enabling Phase 1 diagnostics.
Yusuf El-Masri granted full access to ACCHCO’s terminal operating system data, allowing Phase 1 diagnostics to commence following the kickoff in Alexandria.

In early May, Yusuf El-Masri was asked by Felix Kasiske of RPX Optimization GmbH to dedicate two days of his operations team to the Phase 2 redesign after Phase 1 confirmed that yard congestion stemmed from poor block allocation.

In early May, Yusuf El-Masri's operations team was scheduled to spend two days with Felix Kasiske of RPX Optimization GmbH to begin Phase 2 redesign after Phase 1 confirmed yard congestion was caused by poor block allocation.
